verdict.rationale: Stable can be driven headlessly through its own REST API, authenticated with dashboard-issued API keys sent in the x-api-key header. The API supports searching and retrieving MailItems, creating Locations and onboarding them programmatically, and managing Companies, with webhooks and polling for status changes. However, the documented API surface is self-described as limited, and there is no CLI, SDK, CI-specific guidance or published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404). Many mail actions (scan, ship, shred, deposit) appear only as dashboard features. Missing for 10: CLI or SDK for scripted/CI use, API coverage of core mail actions, CI/automation documentation, OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
